 KCEOC’s LIHEAP Fall Subsidy now taking applications for energy bill assistance
 MAM 
 Posted
 Wednesday, 
 November 11, 2026 
 1:31 pm 
 KCEOC CAP Inc. is now accepting applications for the Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP) Fall Subsidy Component. Applications will be accepted from November 9 through December 18, 2026, or until designated funds are depleted on a first-come, first-served basis. Interested households should contact the Community Action Agency serving their county to determine eligibility and apply. To qualify, households must meet program eligibility requirements, including having a household income at or below 150 percent of the Federal Poverty Guidelines.
Only one person from each household should apply.
If the designated representative (person applying for benefits) is not the head of household or spouse, the representative must have a signed statement giving authorization to apply for the household. Applicants who are unable to apply for themselves or individuals without a designated representative can contact KCEOC LIHEAP staff for assistance or to make other arrangements.
Required Documents:
Applicants must provide the following documentation:
1. Proof of Social Security Number or Permanent Residence card (Green Card) for each member of the household.
2. Proof of all households’ (all members) income from the prior month.
3. Photo ID (Driver’s License/State Issued Photo ID)
4. Most current heating bill, or statement from your landlord if heating expenses are included in your rent, or statement from the utility company if you participate in a Pre-Pay Electric Program.
5. The account number and name on the account for main heating fuel sources and electric bill.
*Additional documentation may be requested as needed for program compliance.
 KCEOC CAP provides LIHEAP benefits in Knox County, KY.
Once an application is approved, a one-time benefit is paid directly to the utility vendor. Assistance received during previous LIHEAP components does not affect household eligibility.
LIHEAP is available in all Kentucky counties. Clients outside KCEOC’s service area can request additional information about LIHEAP from their local Community Action Agency by calling 1-800-244-2275 (TTY available for the hearing impaired.)
Anti-Fraud/Misuse Warning: Do NOT give false information or hide information to receive LIHEAP benefits. You may only use LIHEAP benefits for your household. Misuse could result in termination of your LIHEAP benefits, and you could be prosecuted for fraud. Report any information about fraud or misuse of LIHEAP benefits by calling the Fraud Hotline at 1-800-372-2970.
Applicant Rights: Each applicant will be informed of their rights should they be denied assistance. Should the applicant not be satisfied with the local decision, they may further appeal to the Cabinet for Health and Family Services.
